{{Top|rwm|can|ref|italics=1}} {{ReferenceBook |image=[[File:Star_Wars_Absolutely_Everything_you_Need_to_Know_Cover.jpg]] |title=''Star Wars: Absolutely Everything
You Need to Know'' |author=*[[Adam Bray]] *[[Kerrie Dougherty]] *[[Cole Horton]] *[[Michael Kogge]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Dorling Kindersley|DK Publishing]] |release date=[[September 4]], [[2015]]{{DK|url=us/9781465437853-star-wars-absolutely-everything-you-need-to-know-journey-to-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know|nolive=1}} |type=*Hardcover *Paperback |pages=200 |dimensions= |weight= |isbn=9781465437853 |series=[[Journey to Star Wars: The Force Awakens|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']]{{SW|url=news/journey-to-star-wars-the-force-awakens-publishing-program-coming-fall-2015|text="Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''" Publishing Program Coming Fall 2015}} |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know''''' is a [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference title and part of the [[Journey to Star Wars: The Force Awakens|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']] initiative. The 200-page title was published on [[September 4]], [[2015]] and provides facts about the ''Star Wars'' universe such as the oldest [[Jedi]] and a list of all owners of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. While the title was written in part by one of the same writers as ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', [[Adam Bray]], the two projects are described as being "very different." Readers will find "very little common information between the two" as "''Absolutely Everything'' highlights anecdotal, quirky and obscure facts."{{InsiderCite|158|Blaster}} On [[October 3]], [[2017]], the title was followed by ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''. ==Publisher's summary== ''Star Wars®: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know explores the world of ''Star Wars'' through lively lists, interesting facts, and questions and answers via a highly engaging infographic design. Whether it's a chart of who is the oldest Jedi, a list of all the owners of the ''Millennium Falcon'', or a diagram showing all the Jedi Yoda has trained, this guide will excite readers of all ages and provide facts they never knew about the Star Wars Galaxy.'' ==Continuity== While information from this reference is treated as [[canon]] for [[Holocron continuity database|Holocron]] purposes,{{Twitter|Holocronkeeper|status/832028228885704704|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=As far as the Holocron database is considered, I categorize info from that book as such.|archivefile=File:LelandChee_AbsolutelyEverything_HolocronDB.jpg}} the book also contains the following disclaimer in the back:
In 2014 Lucasfilm reclassified what is considered canon in the ''Star Wars'' universe. ''Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know'' draws mostly upon information from the Expanded Universe that Lucasfilm now considers to be "[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]"―that is, stories beyond the original six films and the TV shows ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' and ''Star Wars Rebels.''
For example, page 186 refers to Palpatine's execution and cloning of [[Bevel Lemelisk]], confirmed to be non-canon by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]].{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/764957468132651008|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Nah. This is old Legends stuff from the Darksaber novel.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo_AbsolutelyEverything_Lemelisk.jpg}} ==Continuity== *[[Padmé Amidala Naberrie]] is established to have stepped down from [[Monarch of Naboo|ruling]] [[Naboo]] in [[24 BBY]]. However, the novel ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' later stated that she stepped down in [[28 BBY]].''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' *[[Adi Gallia]]'s [[homeworld]] is said to be [[Coruscant]], as in ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''.''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' However, ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' says [[Tholoth]] is her homeworld.''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *[[Ahsoka Tano]] is said to have been "almost expelled" from the [[Jedi Order]], whereas she actually was expelled for a short time, as seen in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[The Wrong Jedi]]."{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}} She is also mistakenly described as "a rebel [[Jedi]]." *[[Luke Skywalker]] is mistakenly described as being nineteen [[Standard year|years]] of age when he started his training with Yoda when in actuality, he was twenty-two at the time. *The [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] is said to have a capacity of 139,000 [[B1-series battle droid]]s, while ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' states that it can carry 329,000.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' *[[Qui-Gon Jinn]] is said to be the first and most famous of [[Dooku]]'s apprentices, but according to [[Master & Apprentice]], [[Rael Averross]] was a [[Padawan]] of Dooku before Jinn.''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know}} ===Editions=== *{{ISBN|9781465437853}};
